info.title: Checkout Store API
info.description: Single Serverless Framework HTTP API Gateway (Nest microservices behind `/products|customers|deliveries|transactions`). Import into Apidog. Pay returns HTTP **200** with `paymentStatus` APPROVED|DECLINED|ERROR (DECLINED/ERROR are not HTTP errors). Domain errors use `domainErrorToHttp` bodies; DTO failures use ValidationPipe `{ error, message, details }`. Post-pay stock/delivery effects: SQS worker (sync fallback when queue URL empty). Public docs UI: https://7j6npb6n4w.apidog.io (auto-sync ~every 3h from this OpenAPI).
